functions.name: Serializer engine installed with a valid config
functions.description: The Truvio.Commerce.Serializer package on the host at or above the floor the layers declare, with Files/System/Serializer/Serializer.config.json staged; a config the loader rejects makes every Serializer call fail, the read-only settings read included.

notApplicable.when: the build neither deserializes a Distribution edition nor serializes its own work

functions.name: Serialize (export) to replace and merge trees
functions.description: Serialize writes the configured content and SqlTable predicates of one mode as YAML under SerializeRoot/<mode>/ with a mode manifest, an ownership header per document and a link sweep that fails on orphaned page references; an inline Scope only narrows a predicate.

notApplicable.when: the build only deserializes layers and never serializes its own work

functions.name: Deserialize (import) in Replace then Merge mode
functions.description: Deserialize applies the mode manifest under SerializeRoot: Replace is source-wins, Merge is destination-wins field-level fill. Always send Mode; an empty body runs a live Replace. A dry run gates on failed == 0 and the entry count; a Merge of a table without a primary key can delete host rows.

notApplicable.when: the build deserializes nothing (for example a PIM demo from a blank database)

functions.name: GUID identity across environments
functions.description: Pages and paragraphs are matched by PageUniqueId and ParagraphUniqueId, SqlTable rows by primary key or a resolved match key; numeric ids differ per environment and internal links are rewritten.

functions.name: Strict mode
functions.description: Warnings escalate to a failed run (HTTP 400 naming the entry) under strict mode, the default for API and CLI callers; request parameter overrides config, config overrides the entry-point default. A strict 400 can still describe no defect (dry-run area creation, known grid rows).

functions.name: Package download and unzip
functions.description: PackageDownload returns a page-package zip; Upload plus PackageUnzip stages a mode tree or package zip into SerializeRoot/<mode>/ on a host whose files cannot be copied directly. A rejected zip changes nothing.

notApplicable.when: the mode trees reach the host by direct file copy
The catalogue the build reproduces shows no use of this function in its source documentation; the ruling's evidence names the source pages or census items reviewed.
